items.title: Comscore’s Q1 2026 AI Intelligence Report Shows Scale of Claude’s Breakout Growth as AI Continues to Influence Search, Discovery and Consumer Decisions
items.summary: Comscore, a global leader in measuring and analyzing consumer behaviors, today released its first AI Intelligence Report for 2026, which showed the scale of breakout growth from Anthropic’s Claude platform. The Q1 report based on Comscore’s panel data, revealed that Claude recorded 1,858% growth in desktop conversations between March 2026 and October 2025. While ChatGPT continues to lead the AI assistant category up 55% year over year, the report shows consumers are expanding their use of a wider range of options.

items.title: Comscore Announces Appointment of Matt McLaughlin as Chief Executive Officer
items.summary: Comscore, Inc. (Nasdaq: SCOR), a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms, today announced the appointment of Matt McLaughlin as Chief Executive Officer of the company, effective immediately. Jon Carpenter will transition from his role as CEO and will continue to support the company as a senior advisor to the Board of Directors and CEO until October 2026. In connection with the leadership transition, industry leader Stuart Frankel will join the company’s Board of Directors, filling the seat previously held by Mr. Carpenter.
